purpose: Adapt Teensy4.1 module signals to the mTrain connector abstraction, radio header and two IMU-related external headers, preserving the three0ohm FPGA signal links.

ports.U101: Teensy4.1 module interface; cached pad numbers are source observation pending exact selected-module pin map.
ports.U102: mTrain passive host connector abstraction, not another processor or independent active power source.

authoring_operating_scope: Curator25C passive signal-adapter bench with modules/host represented as disclosed ports: GPIO/SPI signals0/3.3V through100ohm,10k//100pF receivers and only one source per net; I2C external4.7k pullups to3.3V. Source0ohm links are finite conductor paths, exact resistance fixed in task supplement. Separate5V VIN and3.3V rails are externally provided in the passive bench; an actual installed-module variant must disclose which source supplies each rail and avoid back-driving outputs before function proof. No claim two active power sources can be tied.
observables: Correct source-named routing of radio SPI/CE/CS/interrupt and FPGA SPI throughR101/102/103, select/reset/init/done and kick control.
mTrain andTeensy named-pin identity, supply separation and common return.
I2C/IMU interrupt/address routing. J102 contains no ground pin: the external fixture must use the shared return atJ101.1/J103.4 or host GND, rather than asserting standalone4wire plug completeness.
source_caveats: No radio,IMU,FPGA,kicker,robot firmware or motor is installed on this adapter. Source Value names designate external modules/connector roles, not protocol or robotic system guarantees. A source NC or module pin mismatch may require later correction; it does not by itself prevent authoring a local adapter task.
R1_scope: Schematic/dependencies and actual declared public local function only; noPCB/manufacturing/bodyfit/full external system protocol gate. Source observations and intended corrected function are separate.
scope_control: Use actual prompt_policy/current delivery cutoff. No canceled missing-conditions criterion/file.
